caption:
Momo starts before dawn, kneading dough and lugging flour bags. Lately her wrists and shoulders feel tight.

Long stretches of the same movement can leave muscles feeling tight. Mixing up your tasks gives them a chance to have a breather.

Hybi's bakery tips: swap hands when kneading, lift bags close to your body with your knees bent, and fit in short wrist stretches between jobs. Remedial massage may help tight forearms and shoulders feel easier.

Tingling fingers or numb hands at night are worth an assessment first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD remedial massage therapists can help. Book online via the link in bio
